blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States — The Trump administration said Sunday the air travel havoc triggered by a no-takeoff order could drag on for another day, pushing back its timetable for a return to normal. Nearly 2,000 more flights were cancelled, and questions remained over how such chaos could unfold in the world’s largest economy, a country that prides itself on its technological prowess. Stranded passengers wandered through chaotic US airports for a third day. Officials blame Friday’s huge snafu on faulty work to upgrade air traffic control communication cables.
